title: The rundown
note: What's going on right now, in one place. The ↗ links out to the original source; the item's own text turns into a link only once it becomes a full entry here.

items.text: About 200 people are under observation in Russia's Irkutsk region after an Anti-Plague Institute lab worker died of what officials call "pneumonia of unknown etiology"; the WHO says no cause is officially confirmed and the risk to the general public appears low, and no contact has been reported sick.

Brazil's presidential race heads to an October 25 runoff after Sunday's first round, with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro edging ahead of incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva 47% to 45% with more than 99% of votes counted.
Russia struck a bridge in Kyiv on October 4 as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made an unannounced visit to the Ukrainian capital, with air-raid sirens sounding during his trip.

The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded today to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for discovering light-gated ion channels, the basis of optogenetics, which lets researchers switch individual brain cells on and off with light.

NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins commanded SpaceX's Crew-13 to the International Space Station on October 1 aboard Dragon Grace, becoming the first active NASA astronaut to fly twice on a Dragon spacecraft, for a planned six-month stay.

Google released Gemini 4 Argon on September 30 in a limited rollout to vetted cybersecurity teams, with the model beating GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 on 13 of 19 of Google's own benchmarks and posting a 15% hallucination rate versus Astra's 51%.

OpenAI unveiled GPT-6.1 Sol at its September 29 DevDay, pricing it at roughly a fifth of GPT-6 Astra's tokens while cutting its factual-error rate from 11.4% to 7.7%, days after reports it had shelved a more capable Astra successor over its own safety-test results.
The FDA approved AbbVie's Juvmo (tavapadon) on September 28 as the first selective D1/D5 receptor agonist for adult Parkinson's disease, taken once daily with or without levodopa.
A multinational study presented at EADV 2026 found nail detachment in 39% of 575 GLP-1 users versus 9% of 1,329 matched non-users, the first controlled look at the drugs' effect on nail health.
Bitcoin traded around $86,377 on CoinDesk's index early Monday, up about 2% on the day but still roughly a third below the $126,210.50 all-time high it set almost exactly a year ago.

Wall Street closed out last week higher — the Dow up 0.5% to 51,176.96, the S&P 500 up 0.7% to 7,722.72, the Nasdaq up 1.2% to 27,190.86 — before futures slipped Monday morning on rising bond yields and eurozone jitters.
